messages.subject: MENA Energy & Renewables Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Digby Morris Energy & Renewables Team,

Your director-led executive search across MENA energy, renewables and infrastructure aligns closely with my leadership background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC where energy growth requires strong government, regulatory and stakeholder relationships. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
